newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SHV MAINTAINS INTERIM DIVIDEND, SEES LOWER 96 NET.
newsitem.headline: SHV MAINTAINS INTERIM DIVIDEND, SEES LOWER 96 NET.

text.p: Privately-owned Dutch retailing and energy group SHV Holdings N.V. said on Wednesday it would pay an unchanged 1996 interim dividend of 5.50 guilders per share.
The company, which does not publish half-year figures, said it expected the full-year 1996 net profit to be "somewhat lower" than the 568 million guilders of 1995.

"Although the last four months of the year are very significant -- both for SHV Energy and SHV Makro -- one should count on a result of SHV Energy below previous year; SHV Makro expects a result around that of last year," it said.
"This will lead to a result for SHV Holdings which is somewhat lower than in 1995," it said in a statement.
